desc.zh: 逐值去掉正负号，保留大小。图像数值不截断。
desc.en: Remove the sign of each value, retaining its magnitude without clipping.

desc.zh: 设置为加、减、乘或除。按 a 运算 b，图像按对应格逐值计算；图和数配对时，数用于每格。除数为 0 时报告错误。
desc.en: Select addition, subtraction, multiplication or division. Compute a op b elementwise, broadcasting a scalar to image cells. Division by zero reports an error.

arithmetic.compute: match $op { add: add(a, b), sub: sub(a, b), mul: mul(a, b), div: div(a, b) }

desc.zh: 给出彩色像素里第 c 个位置（0、1、2，在元件上选）上的数组成的灰度图。哪个位置是哪种颜色，看图按什么顺序存：RGB 图的 0 是红，BGR 图的 0 是蓝。
desc.en: Gives the grey image of the numbers at position c (0, 1 or 2, set on the part) of each colour pixel. Which colour sits at a position depends on the image’s channel order: in an RGB image 0 is red, in a BGR one blue.
Always gives the number it is set to.

desc.zh: 输入以周为单位的角度。输出 cos(2πa)：0 周为 1，1/4 周为 0，1/2 周为 −1。数或图逐值计算。
desc.en: Compute cos(2πa) for an angle in turns: 0 gives 1, 1/4 gives 0, 1/2 gives −1. Applies elementwise.

desc.zh: 宽为 N 时，把原图每行重复 N 次。另给出每格的位置 x/N、当前重复的索引 k。每行计算一个结果后，用还原形状恢复原宽高。不生成波形或频谱。
desc.en: Repeat every source row N times, where N is its width. Also expose sample positions x/N and repetition indices k. Compute one result per row and restore shape. No waves or spectra are generated.

desc.zh: a 小于 b 时给出 1，否则给出 0。数和数、图和数、同样大小的两张图都行，逐个值算；灰度图和彩色图一起时，灰度的一格配彩色的三个通道。
desc.en: Gives 1 where a is less than b, else 0. Numbers, an image and a number, or two images of one size, value by value; a grey image with a colour one gives each grey cell to all three channels.

desc.zh: 将 x、y 作为两个互相垂直的分量，计算 sqrt(x² + y²)。数值和同尺寸图都可使用。自动计算，不改变方向分量本身。
desc.en: Treat x and y as perpendicular components and compute sqrt(x² + y²). Works on numbers and matching images. The arithmetic is automatic; the components themselves remain unchanged.

desc.zh: 给出两者中大的那个。数和数、图和数、同样大小的两张图都行，逐个值算；灰度图和彩色图一起时，灰度的一格配彩色的三个通道。
desc.en: Gives the larger of the two. Numbers, an image and a number, or two images of one size, value by value; a grey image with a colour one gives each grey cell to all three channels.

desc.zh: 生成与图同尺寸的位置表：每行依次保存 0/N、1/N…(N−1)/N。保存的是位置，不是亮度。
desc.en: Generate a same-size position table containing 0/N, 1/N, …, (N−1)/N in each row. These are positions, not intensities.

desc.zh: 每行独立求和或平均，得到一列结果。平均还会除以该行宽度。数值计算自动完成，RGB 各通道分别处理。
desc.en: Independently sum or average each row, producing a column. Mean additionally divides by row width. RGB channels are handled separately.

desc.zh: 输入是一列逐位置结果，按原来的行序还原为“尺寸参照”的宽高。只排布数据，不做计算。
desc.en: Arrange a column of per-position results into the reference width and height in row order. No arithmetic is performed.

desc.zh: 把表旋转 180 度：行序和每行的次序一起反转。不会对图像做滤波。
desc.en: Rotate a table 180 degrees, reversing both axes. No filtering is performed.

desc.zh: 输出位置 (x,y) 读取输入的 (x+dx,y+dy)。dx 向右、dy 向下为正，须为整数。只改变读取的位置，不改变亮度；图外遵循所选规则。
desc.en: Output (x,y) reads input (x+dx,y+dy). Integer dx is positive right, dy down. Values are unchanged; outside reads use the selected rule.

desc.zh: 给出图的宽 w 和高 h。
desc.en: Gives an image’s width w and height h.

desc.zh: 交换图像的行和列。原来的 (x,y) 成为 (y,x)，宽高互换，数值和通道不变。
desc.en: Exchange rows and columns: (x,y) becomes (y,x). Width and height swap; values and channels remain unchanged.

desc.zh: 横向两端各去掉 rx 列，纵向两端各去掉 ry 行。用于显示邻域完全位于原图内的输出。宽高由系统计算。
desc.en: Remove rx columns at each horizontal edge and ry rows at each vertical edge, exposing outputs whose neighbourhood stays inside. Dimensions are computed automatically.

desc.zh: 核的中心依次对齐每个输出位置。每个位置展开为一行：读数表与权重表按核的书写顺序一一对应。保留 RGB 通道；不翻核、不相乘、不求和。
desc.en: Centre the kernel at each output location. Each location becomes a row of samples and matching written-order weights. RGB is retained. No kernel reversal, multiplication or summation is performed.
